name: Nigredo Labyrinth
source: Isaias is just an average student and cafe manager who thinks his daily life will stay the same forever. But one day a shocking change comes to his life. In order to find out the truth, he enters the labyrinth of memories.
translation: 以赛亚只是一名普通学生，同时经营着一家咖啡馆。他原以为平日的生活会永远持续下去。然而某天，令人震惊的变故打破了这一切。为了查明真相，他走进记忆的迷宫。
